factors.C: squared first derivative instead of absolute amplitude
factors.E: median plus three scaled MADs instead of mean plus one standard deviation for peak height
factors.F: 300 ms instead of 200 ms minimum peak distance

task.utility: One-to-one event F1 within 100 ms, evaluating events in [1,299) seconds; additional 50/150 ms sensitivity. This is a declared development matching tolerance, not a clinical validation criterion.
task.options_origin: authored native-operation configuration choices; no claimed reproduction of a named detector or learned graph model
task.reference_scope: one fixed algorithm, source input, and evaluation cohort; no population or clinical-validity claim
task.shared_code: NumPy is np; signal operations are scipy.signal butter/find_peaks/sosfiltfilt and scipy.ndimage uniform_filter1d; graph operations use NetworkX; fitting uses sklearn LogisticRegression and StandardScaler. Numerical helper access is documented separately.
